mostWorthwhile.text: Comparing Venus’s phases with Tycho’s model was most worthwhile: it showed why evidence against one model does not establish a single alternative.

surprise.text: Venus’s phases rule out the standard Ptolemaic arrangement but also fit Tycho’s stationary-Earth model.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the last two combinations were the only available choices.
